Chop vegetables

Bake at 425°F for 20 min

Sauté garlic in butter, add shrimp 3 min per side
Toss with pasta and lemon juice

Cook ladles of batter in buttered pan

Mix with vegetables and soup
Top with crust; bake at 400°F for 35 min

Mix browned beef, rice, sauce; fill peppers

Add vegetables, cook 4 min

Cook sliced apples and onion in butter

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadillas

Toss with pasta and chicken

Chop everything

Partly blend for a thick texture

Shred chicken

Warm beans
Layer rice, beef, beans; top with salsa, avocado, cheese

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup

Butter bread, fill with cheddar
Toast 3 min per side

recipes.name: Fish Tacos

Mix sour cream with lime juice
Fill tortillas with fish and slaw

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs

Bake at 400°F for 20 min

Warm beans

Simmer cream, tomatoes, parmesan

Serve on bread with lettuce

Cook onion and mushrooms

Shred

Toss together; top with parmesan

Add chickpeas; cook 5 min
Stir in spinach; serve over rice

Sear steak 4 min per side with butter and garlic
Rest 5 min; steam green beans

recipes.name: Fruity Oatmeal Bowls

Top with sliced banana, berries, honey

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs

Mash avocado with lemon juice; spread
Top with fried eggs

steps: Marinate chicken in lemon juice and oil; cook 8 min
Mix yogurt with chopped cucumber
Stuff pitas

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Boil spaghetti; crisp chopped bacon
Whisk eggs with parmesan
Toss hot pasta with bacon, then egg mixture off the heat

recipes.name: Veggie Flatbread Pizzas

Add veggies and cheese
Bake at 425°F for 10 min

recipes.name: Pork Lo Mein
steps: Boil spaghetti
Stir-fry sliced pork 5 min
Add vegetables, soy sauce, and noodles; toss 3 min

recipes.name: Turkey Chili

Add beans, tomatoes, chili powder
Simmer 30 min

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Veggies

Place cod on top with lemon
Bake at 400°F for 15 min

recipes.name: Mushroom Swiss Burgers

Grill patties 5 min per side; top with Swiss
Serve on buns with mushrooms

recipes.name: Chicken Salad Wraps

Mix with yogurt, celery, halved grapes
Roll into wraps

Simmer with onion and broth 10 min
Blend; stir in cream

recipes.name: Tuna Noodle Casserole
steps: Boil noodles
Mix with tuna, soup, peas
Top with cheddar; bake at 375°F for 20 min

recipes.name: Taco Salad
steps: Brown beef with a little seasoning
Layer lettuce, beef, cheese, avocado
Top with salsa and crushed chips

recipes.name: Maple Dijon Salmon

Brush salmon with maple and mustard; add with green beans
Roast 12 min

recipes.name: Stuffed Shells
steps: Boil shells; mix ricotta with spinach
Fill shells, set in sauce
Top with mozzarella; bake at 375°F for 25 min

Roll in tortillas with cheese
Cover with sauce; bake at 375°F for 20 min

recipes.name: Egg Roll Bowl

Add slaw and soy sauce; cook 6 min
Top with green onions

recipes.name: Zucchini Pasta Bake
steps: Boil penne 2 min short of done
Mix with diced zucchini and sauce
Top with cheese; bake at 400°F for 20 min

recipes.name: Breakfast Hash
steps: Crisp diced potatoes and bacon
Add pepper and onion; cook 8 min
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover 5 min

recipes.name: Shepherd’s Pie
steps: Boil and mash potatoes with butter
Brown beef with carrots and peas
Top with mash; bake at 400°F for 20 min

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Sear chicken; boil linguine
Simmer butter, lemon juice, capers 3 min
Return chicken; serve over pasta

recipes.name: Loaded Nachos
steps: Layer chips, beans, cheese on a pan
Bake at 400°F for 8 min
Top with tomato and avocado

recipes.name: Egg Muffins
steps: Whisk eggs; mix in chopped fillings
Pour into greased muffin tin
Bake at 375°F for 20 min

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin Dinner
steps: Rub pork with oil and garlic; surround with vegetables
Roast at 425°F for 25 min
Rest 5 min; slice

recipes.name: Veggie Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs, set aside
Stir-fry carrots and peas 4 min
Add rice and soy sauce; fold in eggs

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Cook cubed chicken 7 min
Add pepper and pineapple; cook 3 min
Stir in sauce; serve over rice

recipes.name: Alton Brown’s Smoked Paprika Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Chop olives; mix with lemon zest and garlic; set aside
Stir paprika, olive oil, half the salt, and pepper into a paste
Cut the bones out of the thighs with kitchen shears, keeping the skin on
Push about 2 tbsp olive mixture under each thigh’s skin; rub paste on top
Spread thinly sliced potatoes and onion on a foil-lined sheet pan; sprinkle with remaining salt
Set chicken skin-up on a rack over the potatoes; bake 55–60 min
For crispier potatoes, remove the rack and bake 5–10 min more

recipes.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Peanut Sauce
steps: Whisk peanut butter, brown sugar, soy sauce, lemon juice, 1 tsp chili garlic sauce, and 1 tsp grated ginger with a little water until pourable
Chop the vegetables; julienne the carrot
Heat both oils in a large skillet over medium-high; sauté onion until translucent
Add chicken, break it up, and cook 5 min
Add mushrooms, carrot, remaining ginger, and garlic; cook 5 min
Stir in hoisin and remaining chili garlic sauce; cook until chicken is done; mix in cilantro and green onions
Spoon filling into lettuce leaves and drizzle with peanut sauce

recipes.name: 4-Ingredient Pesto Chicken Bake
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Pound chicken to an even thickness (about 0.8 in); season with salt and pepper
Drain pesto in a fine mesh strainer, pressing out the excess oil
Place chicken in a baking dish and spread each piece with pesto
Top with mozzarella pearls and a tomato slice
Bake 25–30 min until chicken reaches 165°F; broil 1–2 min at the end if you like
Plate the chicken; drizzle with balsamic glaze if desired

recipes.name: Chorizo-Potato Tacos
steps: Microwave potato chunks with ½ cup water and a pinch of salt, covered, 5 min
Brown diced squash in oil over high heat 3–4 min; season and set aside
Cook chorizo in the same skillet, breaking it up, about 5 min
Add potatoes and their water; toss 5–6 min until browned and chorizo is cooked through
Mix tomatoes, scallion, jalapeño, cilantro, and salt for a quick salsa
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet
Fill with squash and chorizo mixture; top with cheese and salsa (sour cream or guacamole optional)

recipes.name: Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat; season chicken chunks and brown 2–3 min; set aside
Cook garlic, bell pepper, and onion 3–4 min until tender
Stir in curry paste and ginger for about 1 min until fragrant
Pour in broth and coconut milk, scraping up the browned bits
Return chicken; bring to a boil, then simmer about 10 min until slightly reduced
Stir in rice noodles, fish sauce, and brown sugar; cook about 5 min until noodles are tender
Off the heat, stir in green onions, cilantro, basil, and lime juice; season to taste
Serve right away (store leftover noodles and broth separately)

recipes.name: Green Thai Chicken Coconut Curry
steps: Sauté diced onion in oil over medium-high heat about 5 min until soft
Add diced chicken; cook about 5 min until done, stirring often
Add garlic, ginger, and coriander; cook about 1 min until fragrant
Stir in coconut milk, carrots, zucchini, curry paste, salt, and pepper
Reduce heat to medium and gently boil about 5 min until reduced and slightly thickened
Stir in lime juice and cilantro; taste and adjust seasoning (a little sugar or extra paste if you like)
Serve over rice or with naan

recipes.name: Instapot Coconut Chicken
steps: In an Instant Pot, combine chopped onion, smashed garlic, soy sauce, ¼ of the vinegar, an equal amount of water, most of the sugar, and ½ tsp pepper; stir in chicken
Seal and cook on high pressure 8 min
Meanwhile, slice cucumbers and finely chop the chile; toss with the remaining vinegar and sugar and a good pinch of salt; let sit
Cook the rice as the package directs
Release the pressure manually and open the lid
Switch to high sauté and simmer 12–15 min until the sauce thickens slightly (a smaller batch may need less time)
Stir in the coconut cream
Serve chicken over rice with the cucumber salad

recipes.name: Instapot Creamy Goat Cheese Pasta
steps: Add penne, cherry tomatoes, broth, olive oil, oregano, pepper flakes, sliced garlic, and 2 tsp salt to the Instant Pot; stir (it’s fine if not everything is submerged)
Set the goat cheese log on top in the center
Lock the lid and pressure cook on high 5 min
Quick release the pressure, then carefully open the lid
Stir until the tomatoes are crushed and the cheese melts into the sauce
Spoon into bowls and top with chopped basil

recipes.name: Instapot Chicken Bryan
steps: Put chicken in the Instant Pot; drizzle with 2 tbsp oil from the sun-dried tomato jar and set the tomatoes aside
Add Italian seasoning, garlic powder, basil, lemon juice, broth, and butter; lightly salt and pepper
Seal and pressure cook 2 min (fresh or frozen chicken)
Let the pressure release naturally 5–10 min, then vent and open the lid
Stir cornstarch and milk into a smooth slurry; switch to sauté and stir it in; the sauce thickens quickly, then turn off
Drain, rinse, and coarsely chop the tomatoes; stir them in
Serve chicken and sauce topped with a big dollop of goat cheese

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Mix 1 tbsp oil with paprika, coriander, salt, cumin, turmeric, cayenne, cinnamon, and black pepper; toss with chicken and marinate 30 min at room temperature (or up to 3 hours in the fridge)
Simmer rice with a pinch of salt and 2 cups water, covered, on low about 15 min; rest covered 10 min; fluff
Cook chicken in 1 tbsp hot oil over medium-high, turning, until golden and 165°F inside, about 5–7 min per side (in batches if needed)
Rest chicken 10 min, then slice into thin strips
Toss cucumbers, bell peppers, red onion, tomatoes, and feta with pepper flakes, juice of 1 lemon, and the remaining 2 tsp oil; salt to taste
Stir yogurt with dill and the juice of the other lemon
Divide rice among bowls; top with chicken, veggies, yogurt sauce, and hummus; serve with warm pita

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Tuscan Chicken Meatballs With Gnocchi
steps: Mix chicken, panko, egg, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, garlic powder, half the tomatoes, and about half the Parmesan by hand; roll into 1-inch meatballs
In the slow cooker, combine chopped onion, garlic, broth, wine, a splash of oil from the tomato jar, and a pinch of salt; nestle in the meatballs
Cover and cook on high about 4 hours until the meatballs are cooked through
Heat the broiler with a rack in the upper third; move meatballs to a foil-lined baking sheet with a slotted spoon
Stir gnocchi and the remaining tomatoes into the slow cooker; cover and cook on high about 20 min until tender
Meanwhile, broil meatballs 6–8 min, turning halfway, until golden in spots
Stir in spinach, cream, and the remaining Parmesan; return the meatballs; cover and cook about 5 min until spinach wilts
Serve in bowls with extra Parmesan

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Toss chicken with yogurt and half the garam masala; marinate 15 min
Sear chicken in a hot pan until browned; set aside
Cook onion, garlic and ginger 5 min; add tomato sauce and remaining spice
Stir in cream and chicken; simmer 10 min

recipes.name: Beef Bulgogi Bowls
steps: Slice steak very thin
Blend soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and grated pear; marinate beef 20 min
Sear beef in batches over high heat 2-3 min
Serve over rice topped with green onions

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Skewers
steps: Whisk oil, lemon juice, garlic and paprika; toss with shrimp
Thread shrimp onto skewers
Grill or broil 2-3 min per side
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lemon wedges

recipes.name: Chicken Marsala
steps: Pound chicken thin and dredge in flour
Brown chicken in 3 tbsp butter 4 min per side; set aside
Sauté mushrooms and garlic 5 min; add Marsala and broth, simmer 8 min until reduced by about a third
Stir in the last 2 tbsp butter; return chicken to the pan and simmer 3 min, spooning sauce over it

recipes.name: Hoisin Glazed Meatballs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Mix pork, panko, egg, half the green onions and garlic; roll 20 meatballs
Bake 18 min
Simmer hoisin, soy sauce and vinegar; toss meatballs and top with green onions

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Dill Sauce
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; brush salmon with oil and garlic powder
Bake 12-15 min until it flakes
Stir sour cream, dill, lemon juice and a pinch of salt
Spoon dill sauce over salmon

recipes.name: White Chicken Chili
steps: Cook onion 5 min in a pot
Add chicken, broth, beans, chiles and cumin; simmer 25 min
Shred chicken with two forks
Stir in cream cheese and corn until melted

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak Sandwiches
steps: Freeze steak 20 min then slice paper-thin
Cook onion and pepper in butter until soft
Sear steak 2-3 min; mix with veggies
Top with provolone to melt and pile into toasted rolls

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Stir-Fry Noodles
steps: Boil noodles; drain
Sear sliced chicken 5 min
Add broccoli, pepper, carrot and garlic; stir-fry 4 min
Toss in noodles and teriyaki sauce

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F
Whisk oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano
Toss chicken and potato wedges in the mixture; spread in a pan with broth
Roast 45 min, basting halfway

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown turkey; add taco seasoning and water per packet
Separate romaine into large leaves
Spoon turkey into leaves
Top with tomatoes, cheese, avocado and sour cream

recipes.name: Sausage and White Bean Soup
steps: Brown sausage and onion in a pot
Add garlic, broth, beans and tomatoes; simmer 15 min
Stir in chopped kale and cook 5 min
Season with salt and pepper

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Cook linguine; save 0.5 cup pasta water
Melt butter; cook garlic and pepper flakes 1 min
Add shrimp 2 min per side; add wine and lemon juice
Toss with pasta, parsley and a splash of pasta water

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Pork Chops
steps: Season chops with salt and pepper
Sear in oil 4-5 min per side; remove
Whisk honey, mustard, garlic and broth; simmer 3 min
Return chops and spoon sauce over

recipes.name: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Drain beans and pat dry; mash well
Mix in breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and chili powder; form 4 patties
Pan-fry 5 min per side; top with cheese
Serve on buns with sliced avocado

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Skillet
steps: Brown diced chicken with taco seasoning
Add rice, broth, salsa and beans; bring to a boil
Cover and simmer 18 min until rice is tender
Top with cheese, cover 2 min to melt

recipes.name: Tortellini Soup
steps: Brown sausage and onion
Add broth and tomatoes; simmer 10 min
Add tortellini and cook 5 min
Stir in spinach and cream until wilted

recipes.name: Korean Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Cook rice
Brown beef with garlic and ginger; drain
Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar and sesame oil; simmer 2 min
Serve over rice with green onions

recipes.name: Caprese Stuffed Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Cut a pocket in each breast; stuff with mozzarella, tomato and basil
Sear 3 min per side, then bake 18 min
Drizzle with balsamic glaze

recipes.name: Vegetable Lasagna
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; boil noodles
Mix ricotta, egg and half the parmesan
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, sliced zucchini, spinach and mozzarella; repeat
Cover with foil and bake 40 min; uncover 10 min

recipes.name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook penne
Season chicken with Cajun seasoning; sear until cooked and slice
Sauté pepper and garlic; add cream and parmesan, simmer 3 min
Toss in pasta and chicken

recipes.name: Beef and Bean Enchiladas
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Brown beef and onion; stir in beans and cumin
Roll filling in tortillas; place in a dish
Pour sauce over, top with cheese, bake 20 min

recipes.name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
steps: Cook onion and pepper 5 min
Stir in curry paste 1 min, then coconut milk and fish sauce
Simmer 5 min; add shrimp and cook 3 min
Finish with lime juice and cilantro

recipes.name: Chicken and Dumplings
steps: Simmer chicken, broth, carrots, celery and onion 20 min
Remove chicken, shred and return to pot
Stir biscuit mix and milk into a dough
Drop spoonfuls into simmering soup; cover and cook 15 min

recipes.name: Pesto Salmon
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Place salmon in a dish; spread with pesto
Scatter tomatoes around and sprinkle parmesan
Bake 15 min; squeeze lemon over

recipes.name: Orange Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into bites; dip in egg then cornstarch
Pan-fry in oil until golden and cooked through
Simmer orange juice, zest, soy sauce, sugar and garlic until thick
Toss chicken in the sauce

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Veggies
steps: Heat oven to 425°F
Cut sausage, potatoes and veggies into bite-size pieces
Toss with oil and seasoning on a sheet pan
Roast 30 min, stirring once

recipes.name: Chicken Gyros
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt, lemon juice and oregano 20 min
Grill or broil 6 min per side; slice
Grate cucumber into remaining yogurt for tzatziki
Fill warm pitas with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Fajitas
steps: Heat oven to 425°F
Slice chicken, peppers and onion into strips
Toss with oil and fajita seasoning on a sheet pan; bake 20 min
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Salmon
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Wilt spinach with garlic; mix with feta and cream cheese
Cut a pocket in each fillet and stuff
Bake 15-18 min; finish with lemon

recipes.name: Beef Pho
steps: Char halved onion and ginger in a dry pot 5 min
Add broth, cinnamon and fish sauce; simmer 20 min and strain
Soak noodles; slice steak paper-thin
Pour boiling broth over noodles and raw steak; top with sprouts, basil and lime

recipes.name: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Mix rice, broth, soup and diced chicken in a baking dish
Cover with foil and bake 40 min
Stir in broccoli, top with cheese and bake 15 min uncovered

recipes.name: Steak Fajita Bowls
steps: Cook rice; stir in lime juice
Rub steak with seasoning; sear 4 min per side and rest
Cook sliced peppers and onion until charred
Build bowls with rice, beans, sliced steak, veggies and salsa

recipes.name: Hawaiian Chicken Skewers
steps: Cut chicken and veggies into 1-inch pieces
Thread chicken, pineapple, pepper and onion onto skewers
Brush with oil and teriyaki sauce
Grill or broil 12 min, turning and basting

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
steps: Season and sear chicken 5 min per side; set aside
Cook mushrooms and garlic 5 min
Add broth, cream, thyme and parmesan; simmer 3 min
Return chicken and simmer until cooked through

recipes.name: Bang Bang Shrimp Tacos
steps: Mix mayo, sweet chili sauce and sriracha
Toss shrimp in cornstarch; pan-fry 2 min per side
Toss shrimp in half the sauce
Fill tortillas with slaw and shrimp; drizzle with remaining sauce

recipes.name: Lemon Butter Cod
steps: Pat cod dry and season
Sear in 1 tbsp butter 3-4 min per side
Add remaining butter, garlic, lemon juice and capers to the pan
Spoon sauce over fish and sprinkle parsley

recipes.name: Chicken Tortellini Alfredo
steps: Cook tortellini, adding broccoli the last 3 min; drain
Sear diced chicken in 1 tbsp butter
Melt remaining butter with garlic; add cream and parmesan, simmer 3 min
Toss everything together

recipes.name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
steps: Cook onion 5 min; add cumin and cinnamon 1 min
Add cubed sweet potato, chickpeas, tomatoes and broth
Simmer 20 min until potato is tender
Stir in spinach until wilted

recipes.name: Barbecue Meatloaf
steps: Heat oven to 350°F
Mix beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, grated onion, milk, garlic powder and half the BBQ sauce
Shape into a loaf on a lined pan; spread remaining sauce on top
Bake 60 min; rest 10 min before slicing

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
steps: Cook rice
Stir-fry garlic and chile 30 sec; add chicken and cook through
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar
Toss in basil until wilted; serve over rice

recipes.name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; pound chicken thin
Spread with mustard, layer ham and Swiss, roll up
Dip in egg then panko; place seam-side down
Bake 30 min until golden

recipes.name: Taco Soup
steps: Brown beef; drain
Add beans, tomatoes, corn, both seasonings and broth
Simmer 20 min
Serve topped with cheese, sour cream and chips

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wings
steps: Heat oven to 425°F; toss dry wings with baking powder and salt
Bake on a rack 45 min, flipping halfway
Melt butter with garlic
Toss wings in garlic butter, parmesan and parsley

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Dice all the vegetables
Cook onion, pepper and garlic in oil 5 min
Add eggplant, zucchini and squash; cook 10 min
Stir in tomatoes and simmer 20 min

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu
steps: Pound chicken thin
Dredge in flour, egg, then panko
Pan-fry in oil 4 min per side until golden
Slice and serve over rice with katsu sauce

recipes.name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Brown beef with diced onion and carrot
Add tomatoes, beans and broth; simmer 15 min
Add pasta and cook 10 min
Serve with grated parmesan

recipes.name: Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Cook rice
Brush salmon with 1 tbsp soy sauce; bake at 400°F 12 min and flake
Mix mayo and sriracha
Build bowls with rice, salmon, avocado, cucumber, soy sauce and spicy mayo

recipes.name: Turkey and Cheese Paninis
steps: Spread pesto on bread
Layer turkey, provolone and tomato
Butter the outsides
Cook in a skillet pressed with a pan 3 min per side

recipes.name: Chili Mac
steps: Brown beef; add chili powder
Add tomatoes, beans, broth and uncooked macaroni
Cover and simmer 12 min, stirring, until pasta is tender
Stir in cheese until melted

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
steps: Cook onion in butter 6 min; add garlic, ginger and garam masala
Add tomato sauce and simmer 10 min
Add diced chicken; simmer 15 min
Stir in cream

recipes.name: Baked Potato Soup
steps: Cook bacon; crumble and keep 1 tbsp fat
Cook onion in fat; add cubed potatoes and broth, simmer 15 min
Mash partly; stir in milk, sour cream and cheese
Top with bacon and green onions

recipes.name: Cashew Chicken
steps: Toss diced chicken with cornstarch
Stir-fry chicken until golden; add pepper and garlic 2 min
Add soy sauce, hoisin and vinegar
Toss in cashews

recipes.name: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan; roll into tiny meatballs
Bring broth and diced carrots to a boil
Drop in meatballs and pasta; simmer 10 min
Stir in spinach

recipes.name: Sweet Chili Salmon
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Mix sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, ginger and garlic
Brush over salmon and bake 12-15 min
Garnish with green onions

recipes.name: Smothered Pork Chops
steps: Dredge chops in flour; brown 4 min per side and remove
Cook onion and mushrooms in butter 6 min
Stir in remaining flour then broth; simmer until thick
Return chops, cover and simmer 10 min; stir in sour cream

recipes.name: Chicken Pesto Paninis
steps: Cook chicken and slice thin
Spread pesto on bread
Layer chicken, mozzarella and tomato
Brush with oil and press in a hot pan 3 min per side

recipes.name: Szechuan Green Beans and Pork
steps: Blister green beans in a hot oiled pan 6 min; remove
Brown pork with garlic
Add soy sauce, chili garlic sauce, vinegar and sugar
Toss green beans back in

recipes.name: Southwest Chicken Salad
steps: Season chicken with chili powder and salt; grill and slice
Thaw corn
Toss chopped romaine with beans, corn, tomatoes and avocado
Top with chicken, ranch and tortilla strips

recipes.name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
steps: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and garlic; roll 16 meatballs
Brown meatballs in a skillet
Add marinara and simmer 15 min
Cook spaghetti and top with meatballs and sauce

recipes.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Marinate chicken strips in half the coconut milk and curry powder 20 min
Thread onto skewers and grill 4 min per side
Whisk peanut butter, remaining coconut milk, soy sauce, honey and lime
Serve skewers with peanut sauce

recipes.name: Breakfast for Dinner Waffles
steps: Heat waffle iron
Whisk pancake mix, eggs, milk and melted butter
Cook waffles until golden
Brown sausage and serve with waffles and syrup

recipes.name: Lemon Orzo Chicken Soup
steps: Cook onion, carrot and celery 5 min
Add broth and chicken; simmer 15 min, then shred chicken
Add orzo and cook 8 min
Stir in spinach and lemon juice

recipes.name: Steak Tacos
steps: Rub steak with cumin, chili powder, salt and lime juice
Sear over high heat 3-4 min per side; rest and dice
Warm tortillas
Top with steak, diced onion, cilantro and lime

recipes.name: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; halve zucchini and scoop out centers
Brown sausage with garlic and chopped zucchini centers; stir in marinara
Fill zucchini and top with cheeses
Bake 20 min

recipes.name: Honey Sriracha Chicken
steps: Toss diced chicken with cornstarch and brown in oil
Whisk honey, sriracha, soy sauce and garlic
Pour over chicken; simmer until sticky
Top with green onions

recipes.name: Clam Chowder
steps: Cook bacon; crumble, keep fat
Cook onion and celery in fat; stir in flour
Add clam juice, clam liquid and cubed potatoes; simmer 15 min
Add half and half and clams; heat through and top with bacon

recipes.name: Chicken Banh Mi Sandwiches
steps: Toss shredded carrot and sliced cucumber with rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar; let sit 15 min
Marinate chicken in soy sauce 10 min; sear 5 min per side and slice
Mix mayo and sriracha
Fill toasted rolls with spicy mayo, chicken, pickled veggies and cilantro

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; slice eggplant into rounds
Dip in egg then breadcrumbs; bake 20 min, flipping once
Layer in a dish with marinara and cheeses
Bake 20 min until bubbly

recipes.name: Apple Glazed Chicken
steps: Brown diced chicken in oil
Whisk apple juice, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup and garlic
Pour over chicken and simmer 8 min
Thicken with cornstarch slurry

recipes.name: Mediterranean Baked Cod
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Place cod in a dish; scatter tomatoes, olives and garlic
Drizzle with oil and lemon juice; sprinkle oregano
Bake 15-18 min

recipes.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Sliders
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; cook bacon
Brown beef with diced onion; drain
Place bottom buns in a pan; layer beef, ketchup, cheese and bacon
Add bun tops, brush with butter and bake 12 min

recipes.name: Shrimp and Grits
steps: Cook grits in 4 cups salted water 5 min; stir in butter and cheese
Cook bacon; crumble, keep fat
Toss shrimp with Cajun seasoning; cook in bacon fat with garlic 2 min per side
Spoon shrimp over grits; top with bacon and green onions

recipes.name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Wraps
steps: Cook chicken and dice
Cook bacon and crumble
Toss chicken, bacon, cheese and ranch
Fill wraps with lettuce, tomato and chicken mixture

recipes.name: Beef Tips and Gravy
steps: Cube beef, toss in flour and brown in batches
Cook onion and mushrooms in butter 5 min
Add broth and Worcestershire; return beef
Cover and simmer 45 min until tender

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Steak
steps: Season flour with garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper
Dredge steaks in flour, egg, then flour again
Fry in oil 3-4 min per side; keep warm
Whisk 3 tbsp flour into 3 tbsp pan oil, add milk and simmer into gravy

recipes.name: Garlic Lime Shrimp Bowls
steps: Cook rice with lime zest and cilantro
Toss shrimp with garlic, chili powder and lime juice
Sear shrimp 2 min per side
Build bowls with rice, beans, shrimp and avocado

recipes.name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta
steps: Cook penne
Sauté garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes 2 min
Add cream, parmesan and Italian seasoning; simmer 3 min
Stir in spinach and pasta

recipes.name: Cheesy Ham and Potato Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; slice potatoes thin
Mix soup, sour cream, diced onion and half the cheese
Layer potatoes, ham and sauce in a buttered dish
Top with remaining cheese; cover and bake 50 min, uncover 15 min

recipes.name: Pork Schnitzel
steps: Pound pork to 1/4 inch thick
Dredge in flour, egg, then panko
Fry in oil 3 min per side until golden
Serve with lemon wedges

recipes.name: Tex-Mex Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Bake sweet potatoes at 400°F for 50 min
Brown beef with taco seasoning; stir in beans
Split potatoes and fill with beef mixture
Top with cheese, sour cream and green onions

recipes.name: Pierogi and Kielbasa Skillet
steps: Boil pierogies 3 min; drain
Brown sliced kielbasa in butter; remove
Cook onion and cabbage 6 min
Add pierogies and kielbasa and brown 5 min; serve with sour cream

recipes.name: Tuscan White Bean Skillet
steps: Sauté garlic in oil 1 min
Add tomatoes and cook until they burst
Add beans and kale; cook 5 min
Finish with parmesan and lemon juice

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
steps: Cook chicken and shred
Toss with buffalo sauce
Fill wraps with lettuce, diced celery, chicken and blue cheese
Drizzle with ranch and roll up

recipes.name: Salisbury Steak
steps: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg and Worcestershire; shape 4 oval patties
Brown patties 4 min per side; remove
Cook onion and mushrooms; stir in flour then broth
Return patties and simmer 15 min

recipes.name: Spicy Peanut Tofu Bowls
steps: Press and cube tofu; bake at 400°F for 25 min
Cook rice; steam broccoli
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, sriracha, honey and warm water
Build bowls and drizzle with peanut sauce

recipes.name: French Onion Chicken
steps: Slowly caramelize sliced onions in butter 25 min
Season and sear chicken 5 min per side
Add broth and thyme to onions; nestle in chicken and simmer 5 min
Top with Swiss and broil until bubbly

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
steps: Cut potatoes into fries; bake at 425°F for 35 min
Whisk flour, baking powder, salt and cold club soda into a batter
Dip fish in batter and fry in hot oil 4-5 min
Serve with fries and lemon wedges

recipes.name: Chicken Stuffed Shells Florentine
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; cook shells
Mix chicken, ricotta and chopped spinach
Spread half the Alfredo in a dish; fill shells and arrange on top
Cover with remaining sauce and mozzarella; bake 25 min

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef
steps: Slice steak thin and toss in cornstarch
Fry in oil in batches until crisp; remove
Simmer soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and 1/4 cup water 3 min
Toss beef and green onions in the sauce

recipes.name: Zuppa Toscana
steps: Brown sausage with red pepper flakes in a Dutch oven 10-15 min; drain and set aside
Cook bacon in the same pot until crisp, about 10 min
Pour off all but a few tbsp of drippings; cook onion and garlic until soft, about 5 min
Add broth and bring to a boil; add thinly sliced potatoes and simmer until tender, about 20 min
Lower heat to medium; stir in cream, sausage and spinach until spinach wilts and sausage is hot

recipes.name: Chicken Chow Mein
steps: Cook noodles and drain well
Stir-fry sliced chicken until done
Add cabbage, celery and sprouts; cook 3 min
Add noodles and sauces; toss over high heat 2 min

recipes.name: Loaded Sweet Potato Nachos
steps: Heat oven to 425°F; slice sweet potatoes into thin rounds
Toss with oil and salt; roast 25 min
Top with beans and cheese; bake 5 min
Add avocado, salsa, sour cream and jalapeño

recipes.name: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Mix oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme and mustard; rub over pork
Sear on all sides 6 min
Roast 18-20 min to 145°F; rest 5 min and slice

recipes.name: Chicken Enchilada Soup
steps: Cook onion 5 min
Add chicken, broth, enchilada sauce, beans and corn; simmer 20 min
Shred chicken
Stir in cream cheese and cheddar until melted

recipes.name: Baked Ravioli
steps: Heat oven to 400°F
Spread a little sauce in a baking dish
Layer frozen ravioli, sauce and mozzarella twice
Top with parmesan and seasoning; cover and bake 30 min, uncover 10 min

recipes.name: Blackened Tilapia
steps: Mix spices with 1 tsp salt
Coat fish on both sides
Sear in butter in a hot skillet 3 min per side
Serve with lime wedges

recipes.name: Chicken and Rice Soup
steps: Cook onion, carrots and celery 5 min
Add broth, thyme and chicken; simmer 15 min
Remove and shred chicken
Add rice; simmer 15 min and return chicken

recipes.name: Pizza Stuffed Peppers
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; halve and seed peppers
Brown sausage; mix with rice and pizza sauce
Fill peppers, top with mozzarella and pepperoni
Bake 30 min

recipes.name: Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat oven to 425°F; season chicken with lemon pepper
Sear skin-side down in oil 5 min
Add butter, garlic and lemon slices; flip
Roast 20 min until cooked through

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Pot Roast
steps: Season roast and sear 4 min per side (optional)
Put potatoes, carrots and onion in the Crock-Pot; set roast on top
Mix broth, onion soup mix and Worcestershire; pour over
Cook on LOW 8 hrs until fork-tender

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Salsa Chicken Tacos
steps: Put chicken in the Crock-Pot; sprinkle with taco seasoning
Pour salsa over the top
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Shred and serve in tortillas with cheese and sour cream

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Pulled Pork
steps: Rub pork with paprika, brown sugar and salt
Put sliced onion in the Crock-Pot; add pork and vinegar
Cook on LOW 9 hrs
Shred, stir in BBQ sauce and serve on buns

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Add chicken, beans, tomatoes, corn, broth, diced onion and cumin to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Shred chicken in the pot
Serve topped with crushed tortilla chips

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Beef Stew
steps: Toss beef with flour, salt and pepper
Add beef and chopped vegetables to the Crock-Pot
Whisk broth with tomato paste; pour over
Cook on LOW 8 hrs

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Put chicken in the Crock-Pot
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic and ketchup; pour over
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Thicken sauce with cornstarch slurry on HIGH 15 min

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Chili
steps: Brown beef with onion and drain
Add everything to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 8 hrs
Serve with cheese and sour cream

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Chicken and Gravy
steps: Put chicken in the Crock-Pot
Whisk gravy mixes, soup and broth; pour over
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Shred or slice and serve over mashed potatoes or rice

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Lasagna Soup
steps: Brown sausage with onion and garlic; add to the Crock-Pot
Add tomatoes and broth; cook on LOW 6 hrs
Break noodles in; cook on HIGH 30 min
Serve topped with ricotta and mozzarella

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Mississippi Pot Roast
steps: Put roast in the Crock-Pot
Sprinkle with ranch and au jus mixes
Top with butter and pepperoncini
Cook on LOW 8 hrs; shred in the juices

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Chicken Taco Chili
steps: Put chicken in the Crock-Pot
Add beans, tomatoes, corn and both seasonings
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Shred chicken; stir in cream cheese until melted

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Swedish Meatballs
steps: Add meatballs, soup, broth and Worcestershire to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 4 hrs
Stir in sour cream
Serve over cooked egg noodles

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Put chicken, teriyaki sauce, pineapple and garlic in the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Shred chicken in the sauce
Serve over rice with green onions

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Split Pea Soup
steps: Rinse split peas
Add peas, diced ham, chopped vegetables, broth and thyme to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 8 hrs
Stir well until thick and creamy

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Butter Chicken
steps: Add chicken, onion, garlic, tomato sauce and spices to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Stir in coconut milk and butter
Cook on HIGH 15 min more

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Baked Ziti
steps: Brown beef and drain; stir in marinara and water
Layer half the sauce, uncooked ziti, ricotta and mozzarella in the Crock-Pot; repeat
Cook on LOW 3 hrs until pasta is tender
Top with parmesan

recipes.name: Crock-Pot French Dip Sandwiches
steps: Put sliced onion and roast in the Crock-Pot
Mix broth and soup mix; pour over
Cook on LOW 8 hrs; shred
Pile beef and provolone on toasted rolls; dip in the juices

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Add chicken, vegetables, broth and thyme to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 6 hrs
Shred chicken; add noodles
Cook on HIGH 20 min until noodles are tender

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Pork Chili Verde
steps: Cube pork and season with cumin and salt
Add pork, onion, garlic and salsa verde to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 8 hrs
Shred and serve in tortillas with cilantro

recipes.name: Crock-Pot Sweet Potato Lentil Curry
steps: Add lentils, cubed sweet potatoes, tomatoes, onion, curry powder and broth to the Crock-Pot
Cook on LOW 7 hrs
Stir in coconut milk and spinach
Cook 10 min more until spinach wilts

recipes.name: Instapot Chicken and Rice
steps: Sauté onion and garlic on SAUTÉ 3 min
Add rice, broth, paprika and chicken on top
Pressure cook on HIGH 10 min; natural release 10 min
Stir in peas and let sit 2 min

recipes.name: Instapot Beef and Broccoli
steps: Brown sliced beef on SAUTÉ in batches
Add broth, soy sauce, sugar and garlic
Pressure cook on HIGH 12 min; quick release
Stir in cornstarch slurry and broccoli on SAUTÉ 5 min

recipes.name: Instapot Mac and Cheese
steps: Add macaroni, broth, butter and mustard
Pressure cook on HIGH 4 min; quick release
Stir in milk and cheese until creamy

recipes.name: Instapot Chicken Burrito Bowls
steps: Add chicken, broth, salsa and taco seasoning
Add rinsed rice and beans on top (don't stir)
Pressure cook on HIGH 10 min; natural release 10 min
Shred chicken, stir and top with cheese

recipes.name: Instapot Beef Stroganoff
steps: Brown beef on SAUTÉ; add onion and mushrooms 3 min
Add broth and Worcestershire
Pressure cook on HIGH 15 min; quick release
Add noodles and 2 cups water; pressure cook 4 min more, then stir in sour cream

recipes.name: Instapot Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger 3 min
Add chicken, tomato sauce and garam masala
Pressure cook on HIGH 8 min; quick release
Stir in cream

recipes.name: Instapot Spaghetti
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic on SAUTÉ; drain
Add broken spaghetti in a crisscross layer; pour water then sauce on top (don't stir)
Pressure cook on HIGH 8 min; quick release
Stir and top with parmesan

recipes.name: Instapot Pork Carnitas
steps: Cube pork; season with cumin and salt
Add pork, onion, garlic, broth and citrus juice
Pressure cook on HIGH 35 min; natural release 15 min
Shred and broil 5 min until crispy; serve in tortillas

recipes.name: Instapot Potato Soup
steps: Cook bacon on SAUTÉ; remove. Sauté onion 3 min
Add cubed potatoes and broth
Pressure cook on HIGH 8 min; quick release
Mash partly; stir in milk, cheese and sour cream; top with bacon

recipes.name: Instapot Lemon Garlic Chicken
steps: Season chicken; brown in butter on SAUTÉ 3 min per side
Add garlic, broth, lemon juice and seasoning
Pressure cook on HIGH 10 min; quick release
Thicken sauce with cornstarch on SAUTÉ

recipes.name: Instapot Chili Mac
steps: Brown beef on SAUTÉ; drain
Add macaroni, beans, tomatoes, chili powder and broth
Pressure cook on HIGH 4 min; quick release
Stir in cheese

recipes.name: Instapot Pot Roast
steps: Season roast; sear on SAUTÉ 4 min per side
Add broth, Worcestershire and thyme
Pressure cook on HIGH 60 min; natural release 15 min
Add potatoes, carrots and onion; pressure cook 5 min more

recipes.name: Instapot Jambalaya
steps: Brown sausage and chicken on SAUTÉ with pepper
Add rice, tomatoes, broth and Cajun seasoning
Pressure cook on HIGH 8 min; natural release 10 min
Stir in shrimp, cover and let sit 5 min

recipes.name: Instapot Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrots and celery 3 min
Add chicken, broth and thyme
Pressure cook on HIGH 8 min; quick release, then shred chicken
Add noodles on SAUTÉ 6 min

recipes.name: Instapot Butter Chicken Curry
steps: Melt butter on SAUTÉ; cook onion and garlic 3 min
Add chicken, tomato sauce, curry powder and cumin
Pressure cook on HIGH 10 min; quick release
Stir in cream

recipes.name: Instapot Black Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and garlic 3 min
Add rinsed beans, broth and cumin
Pressure cook on HIGH 40 min; natural release 20 min
Stir in salsa and blend partly

recipes.name: Instapot Teriyaki Pork Tenderloin
steps: Sear pork on SAUTÉ 2 min per side
Add teriyaki sauce, broth and garlic
Pressure cook on HIGH 5 min; natural release 10 min
Thicken sauce with cornstarch; slice pork and serve over rice

recipes.name: Instapot Creamy Tuscan Pasta
steps: Sauté diced chicken and garlic 4 min
Add penne, broth and sun-dried tomatoes
Pressure cook on HIGH 5 min; quick release
Stir in cream, parmesan and spinach

recipes.name: Instapot Sesame Chicken
steps: Add diced chicken, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and garlic
Pressure cook on HIGH 3 min; quick release
Thicken with cornstarch slurry on SAUTÉ
Top with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Instapot Loaded Taco Pasta
steps: Brown beef on SAUTÉ; add taco seasoning
Add pasta, broth and salsa
Pressure cook on HIGH 4 min; quick release
Stir in cheese and sour cream

recipes.name: Air Fryer Chicken Tenders
steps: Mix panko, parmesan, garlic powder and paprika
Dip tenders in egg then crumbs
Air fry at 400°F for 10 min, flipping halfway
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce

recipes.name: Air Fryer Salmon Bites
steps: Cut salmon into 1-inch cubes
Toss with oil, honey, paprika and garlic powder
Air fry at 400°F for 7 min
Squeeze lemon over

recipes.name: Air Fryer Pork Chops
steps: Mix sugar and spices
Brush chops with oil and coat with the rub
Air fry at 400°F for 12 min, flipping halfway
Rest 5 min before serving

recipes.name: Air Fryer Chicken Wings
steps: Pat wings dry; toss with baking powder, garlic powder and salt
Air fry at 400°F for 25 min, shaking every 8 min
Toss with buffalo sauce
Serve with ranch and celery

recipes.name: Air Fryer Fish Tacos
steps: Cut cod into strips; dip in egg then panko
Air fry at 400°F for 10 min, flipping halfway
Mix sour cream with lime juice
Fill tortillas with slaw, fish and lime crema

recipes.name: Air Fryer Meatballs
steps: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and garlic; roll 20 meatballs
Air fry at 380°F for 10 min
Warm meatballs in marinara 5 min
Serve over spaghetti

recipes.name: Cinnamon Raisin Bread
steps: Warm the milk until just warm to the touch (about 1 min in the microwave)
Add to the bread pan in this order: milk, butter, egg, salt, sugar, flour, cinnamon, yeast on top
Set the bread maker to Sweet, 1.5 lb loaf, light crust, and press Start
Add the raisins when it beeps for add-ins
Bake about 3 hr; cool on a rack 15 min before slicing

recipes.name: Chocolate Bread
steps: Warm the milk until just warm to the touch
Add to the bread pan in this order: milk, butter, egg, salt, sugar, flour, cocoa, yeast on top
Set the bread maker to Sweet, 1.5 lb loaf, medium crust, and press Start
Add the chocolate chips when it beeps for add-ins
Bake about 3 hr; cool 15 min before slicing

recipes.name: Bread Maker Banana Bread
steps: Melt the butter (about 1 min in the microwave) and mash the bananas
Add to the bread pan: bananas, eggs, melted butter, sugar, vanilla, then flour, baking soda and salt
Set the bread maker to Quick Bread (or Cake), 2 lb loaf, medium crust, and press Start
Add the walnuts when it beeps for add-ins
Bake about 1 hr 40 min; cool 20 min before taking it out of the pan

recipes.name: Bread Maker Pound Cake
steps: Soften the butter and beat the eggs
Add to the bread pan: butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla and milk, then flour, baking powder and salt
Set the bread maker to Cake, 2 lb loaf, light crust, and press Start
Scrape the sides with a rubber spatula once during the first 5 min of mixing
Bake about 1 hr 50 min; cool 20 min, then turn it out

recipes.name: Bread Maker Strawberry Jam
steps: Hull the strawberries and chop them small
Put strawberries, sugar, pectin and lemon juice in the bread pan (no paddle change needed)
Set the bread maker to Jam and press Start
Cook about 1 hr 20 min, until thick
Pour into clean jars; cool, then keep in the fridge up to 3 weeks

recipes.name: Bread Maker Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Add to the bread pan in this order: warm milk, 2 tbsp of the butter, egg, salt, sugar, flour, yeast on top
Set the bread maker to Dough and press Start; it takes about 1 hr 30 min
Roll the dough into a 15 x 10 inch rectangle; spread with the rest of the butter, softened
Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon, roll up, and cut into 12 rolls
Set in a greased 9 x 13 pan; let rise 30 min
Bake at 350°F for 22 min
Beat cream cheese and powdered sugar; spread over the warm rolls

recipes.name: Bread Maker Monkey Bread
steps: Add to the bread pan in this order: warm milk, 2 tbsp butter, salt, sugar, flour, yeast on top
Set the bread maker to Dough and press Start; it takes about 1 hr 30 min
Melt ½ cup butter; mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl
Pinch the dough into 1 inch balls; dip in butter, roll in cinnamon sugar, pile into a greased bundt pan
Let rise 20 min, then bake at 350°F for 30 min
Cool 5 min and flip onto a plate

recipes.name: Bread Maker Lemon Loaf Cake
steps: Melt the butter and zest the lemons
Add to the bread pan: butter, sugar, eggs, milk, zest and 2 tbsp of the lemon juice, then flour, baking powder and salt
Set the bread maker to Cake, 2 lb loaf, light crust, and press Start
Bake about 1 hr 40 min; cool 20 min and turn it out
Stir powdered sugar with the rest of the lemon juice and drizzle over the top

recipes.name: Bread Maker Pumpkin Bread
steps: Add to the bread pan: pumpkin, eggs, oil and sugar, then flour, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt
Set the bread maker to Quick Bread (or Cake), 2 lb loaf, medium crust, and press Start
Add the pecans when it beeps for add-ins
Bake about 1 hr 40 min; cool 20 min before taking it out

recipes.name: Hawaiian Sweet Bread
steps: Add to the bread pan in this order: pineapple juice, egg, butter, milk, salt, sugar, flour, yeast on top
Set the bread maker to Sweet, 1.5 lb loaf, light crust, and press Start
Bake about 3 hr; cool 15 min before slicing

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Sweet Bread
steps: Warm the milk until just warm to the touch
Add to the bread pan in this order: milk, butter, egg, vanilla, salt, brown sugar, flour, yeast on top
Set the bread maker to Sweet, 1.5 lb loaf, light crust, and press Start
Add the chocolate chips when it beeps for add-ins
Bake about 3 hr; cool 15 min before slicing

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; soften the butter
Beat butter, sugar and brown sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips
Drop rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets, 2 inches apart
Bake 10 min, until golden at the edges; cool 2 min on the sheet

recipes.name: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; grease an 8 x 8 pan
Melt the butter; stir in sugar, eggs and vanilla
Stir in cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder, then the chocolate chips
Spread in the pan and bake 25 min
Cool 30 min before cutting into 16 squares

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; melt the butter in a 9 x 13 pan in the oven (about 5 min)
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and milk; pour over the melted butter (don't stir)
Drain the peaches and spoon them over the batter; sprinkle with cinnamon
Bake 45 min, until golden and bubbly

recipes.name: Apple Crisp
steps: Heat oven to 350°F
Peel and slice the apples; toss with lemon juice, sugar and cinnamon in a 9 x 13 pan
Mix oats, flour and brown sugar; cut in cold butter until crumbly
Sprinkle the topping over the apples
Bake 45 min, until the apples are tender and the top is golden

recipes.name: Blueberry Crumble Bars
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; grease a 9 x 13 pan
Mix ½ cup of the sugar with flour, baking powder and salt; cut in cold butter and the egg until crumbly
Press half the crumbs into the pan
Toss blueberries with the rest of the sugar, cornstarch and lemon juice; spread over the crust
Crumble the rest of the dough on top and bake 45 min
Cool completely before cutting

recipes.name: Snickerdoodles
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; soften the butter
Beat butter and ¾ cup of the sugar; beat in egg and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt
Mix the rest of the sugar with cinnamon; roll 1 inch balls in it
Bake 9 min on baking sheets; cool on a rack

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; soften the butter
Beat butter, peanut butter, sugar and brown sugar; beat in egg and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking soda and salt
Roll 1 inch balls and press a crisscross on each with a fork
Bake 10 min, until just set

recipes.name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; soften the butter
Beat butter, brown sugar and sugar; beat in egg and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt, then oats and raisins
Drop rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets
Bake 11 min, until golden at the edges

recipes.name: Lemon Bars
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; line an 8 x 8 pan with foil
Mix soft butter, powdered sugar and 1 cup of the flour; press into the pan
Bake the crust 18 min
Whisk sugar, the rest of the flour, eggs, lemon juice and zest; pour over the hot crust
Bake 22 min, until set; cool, then dust with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Classic Cheesecake
steps: Heat oven to 325°F
Mix graham crumbs, melted butter and 2 tbsp of the sugar; press into a 9 inch springform pan
Beat cream cheese and the rest of the sugar until smooth; beat in eggs one at a time, then vanilla and sour cream
Pour over the crust and bake 55 min, until the center barely jiggles
Turn off the oven and leave it inside with the door cracked 1 hr
Chill at least 4 hr before slicing

recipes.name: Apple Pie
steps: Heat oven to 425°F; let the pie crusts sit out 15 min (a box has 2)
Peel and slice the apples; toss with sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and lemon juice
Line a 9 inch pie plate with one crust; fill with apples and dot with butter
Top with the second crust, crimp the edges and cut a few slits
Bake 45 min, until golden and bubbling (cover the edges with foil if they brown fast)
Cool 2 hr before slicing

recipes.name: Pumpkin Pie
steps: Heat oven to 425°F; line a 9 inch pie plate with one crust
Whisk pumpkin, evaporated milk, eggs, sugar, spices and salt; pour into the crust
Bake 15 min, then lower to 350°F and bake 40 min more, until a knife comes out clean
Cool 2 hr; serve with whipped cream

recipes.name: Pecan Pie
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; line a 9 inch pie plate with one crust
Melt the butter; whisk with eggs, corn syrup, brown sugar, vanilla and salt
Stir in pecans and pour into the crust
Bake 55 min, until set at the edges and just a little wobbly in the middle
Cool 2 hr before slicing

recipes.name: Yellow Sheet Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; grease a 9 x 13 pan; soften the butter
Beat ¾ cup of the butter with sugar; beat in eggs and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt, alternating with 1 cup of the milk
Bake 30 min, until a toothpick comes out clean; cool completely
Beat the rest of the butter with powdered sugar, cocoa and the rest of the milk; spread over the cake

recipes.name: Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; grease two 9 inch round pans
Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt
Beat in eggs, milk, oil and vanilla; stir in boiling water (the batter is thin)
Bake 32 min; cool 10 min in the pans, then on a rack
Heat the cream until steaming and pour over the chocolate chips; stir smooth and let thicken 20 min
Spread between the layers and over the top

recipes.name: Carrot Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; grease a 9 x 13 pan
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt
Beat eggs, oil, sugar and brown sugar; stir in the dry mix, then carrots and walnuts
Bake 40 min, until a toothpick comes out clean; cool completely
Beat soft cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar; spread over the cake

recipes.name: Berry Crisp
steps: Heat oven to 375°F
Toss the berries with sugar, cornstarch and lemon juice in an 8 x 8 pan
Mix oats, flour and brown sugar; cut in cold butter until crumbly and sprinkle on top
Bake 40 min, until bubbling

recipes.name: Bread Pudding
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; melt the butter in a 9 x 9 pan
Whisk milk, eggs, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon
Toss bread cubes and raisins in the pan; pour the milk mixture over and press down
Let soak 10 min, then bake 45 min, until puffed and set

recipes.name: Blondies
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; grease an 8 x 8 pan
Melt the butter; stir in brown sugar, egg and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt, then the chocolate chips
Bake 25 min, until golden; cool before cutting

recipes.name: Sugar Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; soften the butter
Beat butter and sugar; beat in egg and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt
Roll 1 inch balls, roll in sugar and flatten a little with a glass
Bake 9 min, until set but still pale

recipes.name: Strawberry Shortcake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F
Mix flour, ¼ cup of the sugar, baking powder and salt; cut in cold butter, stir in milk
Pat into 6 rounds on a baking sheet and bake 14 min
Slice the strawberries and toss with 1 tbsp sugar; let sit 10 min
Whip the cream with the rest of the sugar
Split the biscuits and fill with strawberries and cream

recipes.name: Cinnamon Coffee Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; grease a 9 x 13 pan; soften the butter
Beat butter and sugar; beat in eggs, sour cream and vanilla
Stir in flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt
Mix brown sugar and cinnamon
Spread half the batter in the pan, sprinkle half the cinnamon sugar, repeat
Bake 35 min, until a toothpick comes out clean

recipes.name: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; melt butter in a 9 inch round pan and sprinkle with brown sugar
Lay the pineapple rings on top with a cherry in each; save the juice
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; beat in oil, egg, vanilla and ⅔ cup pineapple juice (add water if short)
Pour over the fruit and bake 40 min
Cool 5 min, then flip onto a plate

recipes.name: Molasses Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 350°F; melt the butter
Stir butter and ¾ cup of the sugar; beat in egg and molasses
Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger and salt
Roll 1 inch balls in the rest of the sugar
Bake 9 min; they crackle on top

recipes.name: Cherry Cobbler
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; spread pie filling in an 8 x 8 pan
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; stir in milk, melted butter and vanilla
Drop spoonfuls of batter over the cherries
Bake 35 min, until golden

recipes.name: Rice Pudding
steps: Simmer rice in water, covered, 15 min
Stir in milk, sugar and salt; simmer, stirring often, 25 min, until creamy
Stir in raisins and vanilla; cook 2 min
Serve warm or cold with cinnamon on top

recipes.name: Chocolate Pudding
steps: Whisk sugar, cocoa, cornstarch and salt in a pot; slowly whisk in milk
Cook over medium heat, stirring, 8 min, until thick and bubbling
Take off the heat; stir in butter and vanilla
Pour into cups and chill 2 hr

recipes.name: Bananas Foster
steps: Melt butter in a skillet; stir in brown sugar and cinnamon until bubbly, 2 min
Slice bananas lengthwise and in half; cook in the sauce 2 min per side
Stir in vanilla
Spoon over scoops of ice cream

recipes.name: Cinnamon Fried Apples
steps: Core and slice the apples (peel if you like)
Melt butter in a skillet; cook apples 8 min, stirring
Stir in brown sugar and cinnamon; mix cornstarch with water and stir in
Cook 3 min more, until the sauce thickens

recipes.name: Chocolate Fudge
steps: Line an 8 x 8 pan with foil
Melt condensed milk, chocolate chips and butter in a pot over low heat, stirring, 5 min
Stir in vanilla and walnuts; spread in the pan
Chill 2 hr, then cut into 36 squares

recipes.name: Crepes with Strawberries
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, sugar and salt until smooth; rest 10 min
Heat a buttered nonstick pan; pour in ¼ cup batter and swirl thin
Cook 1 min per side; repeat with the rest
Slice strawberries; fill and fold the crepes and dust with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Line an 8 x 8 pan with foil
Melt butter and peanut butter in a pot over low heat, stirring, 3 min
Take off the heat; stir in vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth
Press into the pan and chill 2 hr; cut into 36 squares

recipes.name: No-Bake Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Line baking sheets with wax paper
Bring sugar, butter, milk and cocoa to a rolling boil; boil 1 min
Take off the heat; stir in peanut butter, vanilla and oats
Drop spoonfuls on the paper and let set 30 min

recipes.name: Crispy Rice Treats
steps: Grease a 9 x 13 pan
Melt butter in a big pot over low heat; stir in marshmallows until melted, 3 min
Stir in the cereal until coated
Press into the pan with a buttered spatula; cool 30 min and cut

recipes.name: No-Bake Cheesecake
steps: Mix graham crumbs, melted butter and sugar; press into a 9 inch pie plate
Beat soft cream cheese, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth
Fold in the whipped topping and spread over the crust
Chill at least 4 hr

recipes.name: Banana Pudding
steps: Whisk pudding mix and milk 2 min; stir in condensed milk
Fold in the whipped topping
Layer wafers, sliced bananas and pudding in a dish; repeat, ending with pudding
Chill 4 hr before serving

recipes.name: Chocolate Icebox Cake
steps: Whip cream, powdered sugar, cocoa and vanilla until stiff
Layer graham crackers and cream in a loaf pan lined with plastic wrap, 4 layers
Cover and chill 6 hr, until the crackers turn cake-soft
Turn out and slice

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Balls
steps: Mix peanut butter, soft butter, powdered sugar and vanilla
Roll into 1 inch balls; chill 30 min
Melt the chocolate chips in the microwave, 30 sec at a time, stirring
Dip the balls and set on wax paper; chill 20 min to set

recipes.name: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate chips with ½ cup of the cream in the microwave, 30 sec at a time; cool 10 min
Whip the rest of the cream with powdered sugar and vanilla until soft peaks
Fold the chocolate into the cream in two parts
Spoon into cups and chill 2 hr

sides.label: 🥖 Garlic bread
steps: Split baguette; spread with garlic butter
Bake at 375°F for 10 min

sides.label: 🥗 Caesar side salad
steps: Chop romaine
Toss with dressing and parmesan

sides.label: 🥦 Roasted broccoli
steps: Toss florets with oil and salt
Roast at 425°F for 18 min

sides.label: 🥬 Green side salad
steps: Chop tomato and cucumber
Toss with greens and a drizzle of oil and vinegar

sides.label: 🥔 Roasted potatoes
steps: Cube potatoes; toss with oil and salt
Roast at 425°F for 30 min, stirring once

sides.label: 🫛 Buttered green beans
steps: Steam green beans 6 min
Toss with butter and salt

sides.label: 🥕 Honey roasted carrots
steps: Slice carrots; toss with oil and honey
Roast at 425°F for 25 min

sides.label: 🍚 Steamed rice
steps: Rinse rice
Simmer with 2 cups water, covered, 15 min
Rest 5 min; fluff

sides.label: 🥒 Sesame cucumber salad
steps: Slice cucumber
Toss with rice vinegar and sesame oil

sides.label: 🫛 Edamame
steps: Boil or microwave 4 min
Sprinkle with salt

sides.label: 🍚 Mexican rice
steps: Toast rice in a little oil 2 min
Add salsa and 2 cups water; simmer covered 18 min

sides.label: 🌽 Corn on the cob
steps: Boil corn 8 min
Brush with butter and salt

sides.label: 🥑 Chips and guacamole
steps: Mash avocado with lime juice and salt
Serve with chips

sides.label: 🍓 Fruit salad
steps: Wash and slice fruit
Toss together; chill

sides.label: 🥔 Potato chips
steps: Serve straight from the bag

sides.label: 🍞 Crusty bread
steps: Warm baguette at 350°F for 5 min
Slice and serve

sides.label: 🥬 Coleslaw
steps: Mix slaw with mayo, salt, pepper
Chill 10 min

sides.label: 🥔 Mashed potatoes
steps: Boil cubed potatoes 15 min
Drain; mash with butter and milk

sides.label: 🥬 Sautéed spinach
steps: Heat garlic in oil 30 sec
Add spinach; stir until wilted

sides.label: 🌿 Roasted asparagus
steps: Toss with oil and salt
Roast at 425°F for 10 min

sides.label: 🥔 Hash browns
steps: Bake or pan-fry per package directions until crisp

sides.label: 🍞 Buttered toast
steps: Toast bread
Spread with butter

sides.label: 🥟 Egg rolls
steps: Bake or air-fry per package until crisp (about 15 min)

sides.label: 🍚 Quinoa
steps: Rinse quinoa
Simmer with 2 cups water 15 min
Fluff with a fork

sides.label: 🍋 Lemon herb rice
steps: Rinse rice; simmer with 2 cups water, covered, 15 min
Fluff with lemon juice, zest, and butter

sides.label: 🌽 Cornbread
steps: Mix cornbread mix with egg and milk
Bake per box directions (about 20 min at 400°F)

sides.label: 🫛 Baked beans
steps: Heat beans in a saucepan 8 min, stirring
Season with salt and pepper

sides.label: 🥙 Warm pita and hummus
steps: Warm pita 1 min per side in a dry skillet
Serve with hummus

sides.label: 🥗 Greek salad
steps: Chop cucumber and tomato
Toss with feta, olives, oil, and a splash of vinegar

sides.label: 🥦 Roasted cauliflower
steps: Cut into florets; toss with oil and salt
Roast at 425°F for 25 min

sides.label: 🍠 Sweet potato wedges
steps: Cut into wedges; toss with oil and salt
Roast at 425°F for 30 min, flipping once

sides.label: 🫓 Warm naan
steps: Warm in a dry skillet 1 min per side, or in a 350°F oven for 5 min

sides.label: 🥥 Coconut rice
steps: Rinse rice
Simmer with coconut milk and 1 cup water, covered, 15 min
Rest 5 min; fluff

sides.label: 🥬 Garlic bok choy
steps: Halve the bok choy
Stir-fry with garlic 3 min
Add soy sauce; cook 1 min

sides.label: 🫛 Refried beans
steps: Heat beans with a splash of water 5 min
Top with cheese until melted

sides.label: 🍅 Pico de gallo
steps: Dice tomatoes, onion, and jalapeño
Mix with lime juice, cilantro, and salt

sides.label: 🥦 Garlic broccolini
steps: Sauté garlic in oil 30 sec
Add broccolini and a splash of water; cook 5 min

sides.label: 🍎 Cinnamon sautéed apples
steps: Slice apples
Cook in butter with cinnamon 6–8 min until tender

sides.label: 🍅 Caprese salad
steps: Slice tomato and mozzarella
Layer with basil; drizzle with olive oil

sides.label: 🥒 Parmesan roasted zucchini
steps: Slice zucchini into rounds; toss with oil
Roast at 425°F for 15 min; add parmesan for the last 3 min

sides.label: 🥣 Chips and salsa
steps: Serve chips with salsa

sides.label: 🥒 Dill pickle spears
steps: Serve chilled
